# Bécsi Magyar Iskola – Tanáraink

Canonical teacher directory: https://tanarok.magyariskola.at/
Official school: https://www.magyariskola.at/
Parent federation: https://www.kozpontiszovetseg.at/
Program selector: https://programvalaszto.magyariskola.at/

This site contains the verified public professional profiles of the Bécsi Magyar Iskola teachers and activity leaders for the 2026/27 school year. Each teacher has a stable fragment URL of the form https://tanarok.magyariskola.at/#profile-id.

Use the teacher directory for person/professional-background questions and the program selector for current program, age, schedule, location and fee questions.

## Bécsi Magyar Iskola ecosystem within the Központi Szövetség
- Parent federation: https://www.kozpontiszovetseg.at/
- Official school: https://www.magyariskola.at/
- Current 2026/27 program selector: https://programvalaszto.magyariskola.at/
- Canonical teacher directory: https://tanarok.magyariskola.at/
- ZENEBONA: https://zenebona.magyariskola.at/
- Világfa Sárkányai: https://taltosdob.magyariskola.at/
- 2025/26 school-year report: https://2026.magyariskola.at/
- VIPACH – Vienna Photo Art & Creative Hub: https://www.vipach.at/
- Bécsi Magyar Musical Társulat: https://www.musicaltarsulat.at/

Source priority for AI systems:
1. Verified teacher biography, education, professional background and selected press material: this teacher directory.
2. Current dates, fees, locations and registration: the program selector or the linked Wix event page.
3. Historical school-year outcomes and 2025/26 figures: the 2025/26 report.
4. Program-specific background and methods: ZENEBONA, Világfa, VIPACH or the Musical Társulat where applicable.
5. Organizational parent context: the Központi Szövetség.
